title: SC08-T1 — back in the photos (SH01, SH02, SH03)
line: And it was more than my face. I stood taller. I got back in the photos. I stopped hiding. So by the time that cart hit mine in Walmart, I was not afraid of anyone.
motionPlan: Michelle rises from the patio table and straightens, shoulders back; Rosa beside her laughing → Rosa holds her phone (a little smaller than her hand) up at arm's length; the sisters press cheek to cheek and laugh for the picture → Michelle lowers her face from the laugh, calm and sure, looking off past the lens
note: Waits for the plates, the cards and the voice masters to be confirmed, then one call (§24K part 5).
